# R packages used

A variety of R packages was used for this analysis.  All graphics and data wrangling were handled using the [tidyverse suite of packages](https://www.tidyverse.org/).  All packages used are available from the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN), Bioconductor.org, or Github.  

***

# RV growth results

## Data preparation

```{r RV growth data prep}
dat <- read.csv(file = 'fig6_RV_growth_res.csv')
dat$Time <- as.factor(dat$Time) %>%
  factor(levels = c('24', '48'))
dat$Crypto <- as.factor(dat$Crypto) %>%
  factor(levels = c('No coinfection', 'Coinfection with C. parvum'))
dat$analyte <- as.factor(dat$analyte)

RV_dat <- subset(dat, analyte == 'RV')
```

## Statistics

```{r RV growth - Shapiro}
RV_shapiro <- subset(dat, Time == 48) %>% 
  group_by(Crypto) %>% 
  shapiro_test(fold)

datatable(RV_shapiro)
```

```{r RV growth - Wilcoxon}
RV_wilcoxon <- subset(RV_dat, Time == '48') %>%
  group_by(Time) %>% 
  wilcox_test(fold ~ Crypto)  %>%
  add_significance() %>% 
  add_xy_position(x = 'Time', dodge = .75)

RV_wilcoxon$xmin <- RV_wilcoxon$xmin-1
RV_wilcoxon$xmax <- RV_wilcoxon$xmax-1

datatable(RV_wilcoxon)
```

## Plot

```{r RV growth plot}

RV_plot <- ggbarplot(
  subset(RV_dat, Time == '48'),
  'Time',
  'fold',
  fill = 'Crypto',
  color = 'black',
  palette = brewer.pal(n = 3, name = 'Paired'),
  position = position_dodge(.85),
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  add.params = list(
    color = 'black',
    shape = 21,
    fill = 'Crypto',
    jitter = 0.1,
    width = .3
  ),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  ylab = 'Rotavirus fold growth',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
) %>%
  ggpar(legend = 'none',
        xlab = FALSE,
        ylim = c(0,2000))

RV_plot <- RV_plot +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    RV_wilcoxon,
    label = 'p.signif',
    tip.length = .01,
    hide.ns = T,
    remove.bracket = F
  )

print(RV_plot)
```

***

# IFNL3 results

## Data preparation

```{r IFNL3 growth data prep}
IFNL3_dat <- subset(dat, analyte == 'IFNL3')
```

## Statistics

```{r IFNL3 statistics - Shapiro 24h}
IFNL3_shapiro_24 <-
  subset(IFNL3_dat, Time == 24 &
           Crypto == 'Coinfection with C. parvum') %>%
  group_by(Crypto) %>%
  shapiro_test(fold)

datatable(IFNL3_shapiro_24)
```

```{r IFNL3 statistics - Shapiro 48h}
IFNL3_shapiro_48 <- subset(IFNL3_dat, Time == 48) %>%
  group_by(Crypto) %>%
  shapiro_test(fold)

datatable(IFNL3_shapiro_48)
```
```{r IFNL3 statistics - Anova}
IFNL3_anova <- IFNL3_dat %>% 
  anova_test(fold ~ Crypto)

datatable(IFNL3_anova)
```

```{r IFNL3 statistics - Tukey HSD}
IFNL3_tukey <- IFNL3_dat %>%
  group_by(Time) %>%
  tukey_hsd(fold ~ Crypto) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = 'Time', dodge = .75)

datatable(IFNL3_tukey)
```

## Plot

```{r IFNL3 plot}
IFNL3_plot <- ggbarplot(
  IFNL3_dat,
  'Time',
  'fold',
  fill = 'Crypto',
  color = 'black',
  position = position_dodge(.85),
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  add.params = list(
    color = 'black',
    shape = 21,
    fill = 'Crypto',
    jitter = 0.1,
    width = .3
  ),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  ylab = 'IFNL3 mRNA fold change',
  xlab = 'Time since <i>C. parvum</i> infection (h)',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
) %>%
  ggpar(legend = 'top',
        ylim = c(0, 500)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(labels = c("No coinfection", expression(paste(
    "Coinfection with ", italic("C. parvum")
  ))),
  palette = "Paired") +
  theme(axis.title.x = ggtext::element_markdown())

IFNL3_plot <- IFNL3_plot +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    IFNL3_tukey,
    label = 'p.adj.signif',
    tip.length = .01,
    hide.ns = T,
    remove.bracket = F
  )

print(IFNL3_plot)
```

# Vaccine strains growth results

## Data preparation

```{r vaccine data prep}
vaccine_dat <- read.csv(file = 'fig6_vaccine_growth.csv')
vaccine_dat$Time <- as.factor(vaccine_dat$Time) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('24'))
vaccine_dat$Crypto <- as.factor(vaccine_dat$Crypto) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('NI', 'I'))
vaccine_dat$analyte <- as.factor(vaccine_dat$analyte)
vaccine_dat$RV_strain <- as.factor(vaccine_dat$RV_strain)

vaccine_dat <- na.omit(vaccine_dat)
```

## Statistics

```{r vaccine statistics - Shapiro}
vaccine_shapiro <- vaccine_dat %>%
  group_by(Crypto, RV_strain) %>%
  shapiro_test(fold)

datatable(vaccine_shapiro)
```

```{r vaccine statistics - Outliers}
vaccine_outliers <- vaccine_dat %>%
  group_by(Time, Crypto, RV_strain) %>%
  identify_outliers(fold)

datatable(vaccine_outliers)
```
```{r removing outliers from data}
vaccine_dat <-
  vaccine_dat[-which(vaccine_dat$fold == max(subset(
    vaccine_dat, RV_strain == 'RV5' & Crypto == 'I'
  )$fold)), ]
vaccine_dat <-
  vaccine_dat[-which(vaccine_dat$fold == max(subset(
    vaccine_dat, RV_strain == 'RV5' & Crypto == 'NI'
  )$fold)), ]
vaccine_dat <-
  vaccine_dat[-which(vaccine_dat$fold == max(subset(
    vaccine_dat, RV_strain == 'RV5' & Crypto == 'NI'
  )$fold)), ]
```
```{r vaccine statistics - Wilcoxon}
vaccine_wilcoxon <- vaccine_dat %>%
  group_by(Time, RV_strain) %>%
  wilcox_test(fold ~ Crypto) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = 'Time', dodge = 0.75, scales = 'free') %>%
  add_significance()

datatable(vaccine_wilcoxon)
```

## Plot

```{r vaccine Plot}
vaccine_plot <- ggbarplot(
  vaccine_dat,
  'Time',
  'fold',
  facet.by = 'RV_strain',
  scales = 'free_y',
  fill = 'Crypto',
  palette = brewer.pal(n = 3, name = "Paired"),
  color = 'black',
  position = position_dodge(.85),
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  add.params = list(
    color = 'black',
    shape = 21,
    fill = 'Crypto',
    jitter = 0.1,
    width = .3
  ),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  ylab = 'RV fold growth',
  # title = 'CXCL1',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
) %>%
  ggpar(legend = 'none',
        xlab = 'Time since RV infection (h)')


vaccine_plot <- vaccine_plot +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    vaccine_wilcoxon,
    label = "p.signif",
    tip.length = .01,
    hide.ns = T,
    remove.bracket = F
  )

print(vaccine_plot)
```

# Vaccine growth inhibition

## Data preparation

```{r vaccine inhibition data prep}
vaccine_inhib <- read.csv(file = 'fig6_vaccine_inhibition_res.csv')
vaccine_inhib$RV_strain <- as.factor(vaccine_inhib$RV_strain)
```

## Statistics

```{r vaccine inhibition statistics - Shapiro}
vaccine_inhib_shapiro <- vaccine_inhib %>% 
  group_by(RV_strain, Crypto) %>% 
  shapiro_test(percent_inhib)

datatable(vaccine_inhib_shapiro)
```
```{r vaccine inhibition statistics - Wilcoxon}
vaccine_inhib_wilcoxon <- vaccine_inhib %>% 
  group_by(Crypto) %>% 
  wilcox_test(percent_inhib ~ RV_strain) %>% 
  add_significance() %>% 
  add_xy_position(x = 'RV_strain')

datatable(vaccine_inhib_wilcoxon)
```
## Plot

```{r vaccine inhibition plot}
vaccine_inhib_plot <- ggbarplot(
  vaccine_inhib,
  'RV_strain',
  'percent_inhib',
  fill = '#1F78B4',
  color = 'black',
  position = position_dodge(.85),
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  add.params = list(
    color = 'black',
    shape = 21,
    fill = '#1F78B4',
    jitter = 0.1,
    width = .3
  ),
  error.plot = 'upper_errorbar',
  ylab = '% of RV growth inhibition',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10)) %>% 
  ggpar(legend = 'top',
        xlab = '     ') +
  scale_fill_brewer(labels = c("No coinfection", expression(paste(
    "Coinfection with ", italic("C. parvum")
  ))),
  palette = "Paired")

vaccine_inhib_plot <- vaccine_inhib_plot +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    vaccine_inhib_wilcoxon,
    label = "p.signif",
    tip.length = .01,
    hide.ns = F,
    remove.bracket = F,
    bracket.nudge.y = 5,
    size = 2
  )

print(vaccine_inhib_plot)
```

# RV shedding

## Data preparation

```{r RV shedding data prep}
dat_shed <- read.csv(file = 'mouse1_shed_res.csv', stringsAsFactors = F)
dat_shed$time <- as.factor(dat_shed$time)
dat_shed$group <- as.factor(dat_shed$group) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('RV', 'Cp+RV'))
```

## Statistics

```{r RV shedding statistics - Kruskal}
shed_kruskal <- dat_shed %>% 
  kruskal_test(shedding ~ group)

datatable(shed_kruskal)
```
```{r RV shedding statistics - Dunn}
shed_dunn <- subset(dat_shed, time != '1') %>% 
  group_by(time) %>% 
  dunn_test(shedding ~ group, p.adjust.method = "fdr") %>% 
  add_significance() %>% 
  add_y_position()

shed_dunn$xmin <- shed_dunn$time
shed_dunn$xmax <- shed_dunn$time

datatable(shed_dunn)
```

## Plot

```{r RV shedding plot}
shed_plot <- ggline(
  dat_shed,
  'time',
  'shedding',
  color = 'group',
  add = c('mean_se', 'jitter'),
  add.params = list(
    shape = 21,
    fill = 'white',
    jitter = 0.05,
    size = 2
  ),
  ylab = 'RV (FFU/mg feces)',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
) %>%
  ggpar(
    legend = 'none',
    yscale = 'log10',
    xlab = F,
    ylim = c(10, 10000)
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    shed_dunn,
    label = 'p.adj.signif',
    hide.ns = T,
    remove.bracket = T,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(labels = c('RV',
                                expression(paste(
                                  "RV + ", italic('C. parvum')
                                ))),
                     palette = 'Paired')

print(shed_plot)
```

# Diarrhea

## Data preparation

```{r Mouse diarrhea prep}
dat_diarrhea <- read.csv(file = 'mouse1_diarrhea_res.csv', stringsAsFactors = F)
dat_diarrhea$time <- as.factor(dat_diarrhea$time)
dat_diarrhea$group <- as.factor(dat_diarrhea$group) %>% 
  factor(levels = c('RV', 'Cp+RV', 'Cp'))
```

## Plot

```{r Mouse diarrhea plot}
diarr_plot <- ggline(
  dat_diarrhea,
  'time',
  'diarrhea',
  color = 'group',
  scales = 'free',
  xlab = 'Time since RV infection (d)',
  ylab = 'Diarrhea (%)',
  legend.title = '',
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 10
  )
) %>%
  ggpar(legend = 'top') +
  scale_color_brewer(labels = c(
    'RV',
    expression(paste("RV + ", italic('C. parvum'))),
    expression(paste(italic('C. parvum')))),
    palette = 'Paired'
  ) +
  theme(axis.title.x = ggtext::element_markdown())


print(diarr_plot)
```

# Figure building

```{r Figure building}
layout <- '
AAAAAAAAAAAA
BBBBBBBBCCCC
DDDDDDDDEEEE
FFFFFFFGGGGG
'

guide_area() + 
  IFNL3_plot +
  RV_plot + 
  vaccine_plot + 
  vaccine_inhib_plot + 
  diarr_plot +
  shed_plot +
  plot_layout(design = layout, guides = "collect")
```
